verdict.rationale: A telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question for an online filing portal like SOSPortal, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers only filing, search, payment, MFA and robots.txt crawler rules, with no privacy policy, analytics, cookie or tracking opt-out controls. The robots.txt crawler bans govern bots, not user telemetry, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
